findings.reason: The supplied p.708 scan shows the 幫(帮) headword and its explanation, while the adjacent glyph specimens g001–g003 are not individually identified here. The article’s claims about 帮’s current split, 幫 variant status, and proposed 帛-to-巾 relation cite the independently transcribed book explanation (X-bb98d9ba88c32bd4568f; X-69eee64a7c430891836f) and the inspected variant-dictionary analysis (X-d891a8a2cb360d54b5ba), not those specimen identities. The unresolved specimens therefore support no article claim; this disposition does not resolve their identities or certify the page.
